_comment: Rates are micros of the accounting currency per 1,000,000 tokens.
1000000 micros = 1.00. So 3000000 means 3.00 per million tokens.
Keys are '<provider>/<model>'. The provider is the registry name — the
plain one, not a 'provider=model' chain entry — and the model is what the
A model listed in 'unpriced' is one nobody has filled a rate in for yet.
Its calls are recorded with a cost of zero and counted by
spend.Repository.CountUnpriced, so the gap shows up at the top of the
spend report rather than quietly understating every total. The test in
this package fails if a model is neither priced nor acknowledged here, so
adding a provider cannot silently produce free customers.
